domainhints: CareSource OUTBOUND EDI 834 to CSSHealth / Claresthealth (ClarestHealth), adding the CCA line of business - CCA is the LOB name, MADUAL the token used in file names and masks. Edifecs ST runs the ClarestHealth Map on proprietary extracts from Enrollment IT. SEGMENT GLOSSARY (authoritative): Maintenance Reason Code = Loop 2000 INS04, sourced from proprietary field MAINTENANCE_CODE (Dependencies calls it Maintenance_Reason_Code; MAINTENANCE_CODE is the field name). Member death date = Loop 2000 INS12, populated only when Death_Date is not null. Member identifier = Loop 2000 REF*0F - migrated members carry the 10-digit CCA-assigned Member ID, net-new members the 11-digit CareSource Member ID (9-digit Facets SBSB ID plus literal 00). MTM opt-out = 2750 loop, built only when MTM_OPT_OUT_INDICATOR has a value; prod shape LX*3~ then N1*75*MTM_OPT_OUT~ then REF*ZZ*<value>~ (sample REF*ZZ*N~). Name elements by qualifier - INS04, INS12, REF*0F, REF*ZZ, N1*75 - never by a bare ordinal. NAMING AND INTAKE: prop files land on \\day<env>appfs01\<env>_applications\Applications\VendorExtractUtility\CSSHealth (the description writes crt_applications; the AC-2 placeholder form governs); MADUAL_CSSHealth_C_CCYYMMDDHHSS.txt via mask MADUAL_CSSHealth_C*, MADUAL_CSSHealth_F_CCYYMMDDHHSS.txt via mask MADUAL_CSSHealth_F*, with the Tidal job updated for the new masking. Outbound names are CS_MADUAL_CLAREST_P_INCR_834_YYYYMMDDhhmmss.edi and CS_MADUAL_CLAREST_P_FULL_834_YYYYMMDDhhmmss.edi, qualifier P for production and T for test - AC-6 governs, the CS_CLAREST_* form in Important Information is superseded, and the trailing GUID carried by the old CARESOURCE_CSSHEALTH_* names is dropped, so assert its absence. Both old examples are labelled Change file; the second is the FULL file, a typo. Resolve every file name to a concrete timestamp; never leave YYYYMMDDhhmmss or CCYYMMDDHHSS as a placeholder. SCOPE: outbound and test-only - no inbound intake, acknowledgement-return or vendor-side load steps; vendor confirmation is a documented approval, not a technical check. Change/incremental and full are separate prop files producing separate outbound files and are tested as separate cases, never combined. Files must pass SNIP 1 and SNIP 2 before delivery to \\daycrtappfs01\Projects\CSSHEALTH\From_CareSource. COVERAGE: pair each positive with its direct negative - INS12 absent when Death_Date is null, no 2750 loop when MTM_OPT_OUT_INDICATOR is empty - and split migrated versus net-new member identifier into separate cases. Every case walks the full pipeline at atomic depth - prop file drop under its resolved literal name, Tidal mask pickup, Edifecs ST map, outbound file generation under its resolved literal name, element validation, SNIP 1 and SNIP 2, delivery with approval evidence - 5 steps minimum; do not compress the flow.
